description: This is a Bash shell script for managing OCI containers via JSON-RPC HTTP requests. It provides functions for starting containers from bundles or specifications, stopping, listing, retrieving info, pausing, resuming, and executing commands inside containers. The script also includes a command loop for user interaction.

methods.name: start_container_from_bundle
methods.description: Starts an OCI container from a specified bundle directory or tarball.

methods.name: start_container_from_spec
methods.description: Starts an OCI container using a Dobby specification JSON file.

methods.name: stop_container
methods.description: Stops a running container by its ID.

methods.name: get_container_info
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific container.

methods.name: get_container_state
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of a specific container.

methods.name: execute_command
methods.description: Executes a command inside a container with optional parameters.

methods.name: ocicontainer_help
methods.description: Displays help information about available commands.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main loop handling user input and command execution.
